image_pattern_summary: Verified good PEB images predominantly show completed industrial buildings from exterior ground-level or aerial drone perspectives, featuring profiled metal cladding in blue, white, grey, or teal colour schemes with large bay openings or roller shutter doors. Aerial shots effectively convey building scale, roof profile (corrugated/insulated), ridge ventilators, and multi-bay footprint. Ground-level exterior shots show facade cladding, structural form, and entry points — both angles are buyer-useful for evaluating span, height, and finish quality.
